title: Musinsa brings Japanese fashion to Seoul with Zozotown
caption:
South Korean fashion platform Musinsa is teaming up with Japan's Zozotown to bring 15 Japanese apparel brands directly to Seoul. After years of sending K-fashion to Tokyo, the companies are testing local demand in Seongsu with a limited pop-up.

Source: Koreaherald - Musinsa brings Japanese fashion to Seoul with Zozotown
